scope: Preimplementation mathematical assessment of a new raw writer; no native recount or decipherment.

decision_note.unknown: Can the proposed complete self-contained positional concordance, with one minimal-base22 integer per visible group, accommodate the retained long groups without enormous output?
decision_note.outcomes: A small compatible output would justify further source assessment; a forced enormous output stops this exact carrier before implementation.
decision_note.smallest_test: Prove a bound on all numeric fields from the number of explicitly emitted groups; reuse old1299length witness, no new corpus access.
decision_note.budget: 10minutes for contract review, proof, record and publication; no encoder/corpus run.

assumptions: Every source occurrence position is explicitly emitted as one group.
Every source line has an explicitly emitted word-count field.
Every character of each dictionary word is emitted as one ASCII-valued group.
Other fields are source-word count, line count, distinct-word count, per-word length and frequency, and occurrence positions. No additional unbounded IDs, checksums or payload integers.
Each number uses shortest base22 notation, one working unit per digit, with0written as one digit.
M denotes all output groups of the complete self-contained message, not only an excerpt.
proof: Nsourcewords<=M because Npositions are emitted. Eachposition<=N.
Llines<=M because eachline has its count group; eachlinecount<=N.
Eachdictionarywordlength<=M because its individual characters are explicitly emitted.
An11digit minimalbase22 numeral has value>=22**10=26559922791424. Since this exceeds127, its presence requiresM>=26559922791424.

source_witness.limits: Inherited exact working-unit and complete-group premise; earlier imagecheck supported local inner seam, not every sign or authorial boundary. No new image or recount.

decision: Do not implement this carrier as a Voynich candidate. Retain the raw complete idea and its enormous conditional cost; no new field joining, nonminimal zeros or external unrecorded dictionary repair.
limits: This is not GDT1299sourceblockconversion: the new bound comes from paying all concordance positions and wordspellings in the output itself.

Not a general exclusion of concordances, numbers, dictionary notation or the manuscript being a fragment. For a fragment the bound applies to the complete external message, which is not supplied by this contract.
No exact word meaning or native numeral value is assigned.
No source-language/cipher rejection and no new manuscript statistic.
independent_contract_review: Root read all writer/reader fields, domain, framing and examples; producer confirmed all field categories are bounded by max(M,127).
exact_group_cost: M=N+A+2D+L+3, where A is the total character count of distinct dictionary words.

validation.scope: Three authored examples and arithmetic only; not an empirical corpus run.
